Job Description: **Floral Designer/Client Service Position**

Job Overview:

Gorgeous \& Beautiful is a fun, social retail experience that focuses on flowers. G\&B is much more than a mere florist or bucket shop. Our customers come to us for something special, both the experience of interacting with us and the unique beauty of the arrangements they take home with them.

We're looking for a dynamic and experienced Floral Creative/Designer with a great aesthetic sense and diverse style capabilities, someone whose understanding of client service is matched by their love of flowers and plants. Through working in collaborative fashion, this person will elevate our designs and also guide our customers in the proper care and maintenance of their purchases. They will be a key member of our team as we drive sales and loyalty while managing costs and ensuring the profitability of our store.

DO NOT APPLY IF YOU DO NOT HAVE AT LEAST ONE YEAR OF RETAIL FLORAL DESIGN EXPERIENCE

Primary Functions:

Client Service:

\- a proven track record of exceptional client service

\- high level of product knowledge

\- able to create a memorable experience and space for clients

\- able to build an ongoing relationship with clients too drive repeat purchase

Beautiful Design:

\- exceptional and versatile design capabilities

\- high standards of product excellence and consistency of delivery

\- collaborative and creative when it comes to delivering new designs for our discerning customers

\- ensuring our packaging always meets our brand standards

Organizational Skills:

\- able to maintain a clean, well\-organized work area

\- able to manage inventory and costs with the support of the owners

Opening/Closing Procedures:

\- comfortable with opening and closing the store

\- flexible when it comes to seasonal hours

Pay: $25\.00\-$27\.00 per hour

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Toronto, ON M5E 1B3: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (preferred)

Experience:

* florist: 1 year (required)

Job Title: Manager, The Phil & Eli Taylor Performance Academy for Young Artists
Company Name: The Royal Conservatory
Location: Toronto, ON, CA
Date Posted: 2026-07-30
Job Type: full
Remote: yes
Salary: $60,000
Job URL: https://rcmusic.hua.hrsmart.com/pm_module/cgi-bin/click.cgi?job_id=817&site_id=148
Source: indeed
Job Description: Job Description:  

The Royal Conservatory (RCM) is one of the largest and most respected music education institutions in the world, providing the definitive standard of excellence in curriculum design, assessment, performance training, and teacher certification. Graduates from its two performance training programs, The Glenn Gould School and The Phil \& Eli Taylor Performance Academy for Young Artists, regularly perform on major international stages. The RCM is also a leader in the development of early childhood education programs and arts\-based social programs, and presents a diverse range of concerts featuring the finest Canadian and international artists in its magnificent performance space, Koerner Hall. Please visit www.rcmusic.com for more information.  



**What is the Opportunity?**
----------------------------


The Manager, The Phil and Eli Taylor Performance Academy for Young Artists is responsible for the school’s management and administration. Reporting to the Assistant Director, the role provides administrative support and is responsible for coordinating various school and student bookings and maintaining online platforms. The Manager is a primary collaborator with several internal departments. In addition to this, they ensure that all required communications are distributed and collected from students, parents, faculty, and enquiries are responded to in a timely manner.  



**Main Duties \& Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------


* Manage front desk and Academy email; first point of contact for internal and external inquiries and updates.
* Liaise with faculty and internal departments for weekly schedule and setup requirements.
* Update content and assist faculty for online learning platform (Moodle).
* Process and track contractor invoices and POS transactions.
* Collect student information and work with internal departments to maintain Academy accounts and rosters, supporting safety processes.
* Collect and maintain attendance records, notify students/families/faculty as needed, supporting safety processes.
* Collect and track class marks; prepare and enter grades into the Student Information System.
* Create event programs in coordination with faculty and staff.
* Attend all Academy events, providing on\-site support as needed.
* Attend outreach engagements when staff facilitation is necessary.
* Provide audition and jury support.
* Maintain content for Taylor Academy sections of the website.
* Assist in overall marketing plan for each year, including promotion, recruitment, outreach, and alumni engagement; collaborate on social media content.
* Review and distribute all Academy concert recordings.
* Maintain archival records and histories.
* Hire musicians for internal concerts and events as needed.
* Support staff and faculty in program delivery.
* Perform other administrative duties, as required.

  

  

  

**Job Requirements:**  

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


* Completion of a post\-secondary education in a related field with at least 3 years of administration experience preferably in an arts or academic setting, or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented, effectively manages competing priorities and deadlines.
* Reliable and consistent time management.
* Exceptional communication skills (verbal \& written) with internal and external stakeholders at all levels demonstrating tact and diplomacy at all times.
* High degree of initiative and the ability to proactively solve problems.
* Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook. Familiarity with databases.

**Salary**
----------


* $60,000 per annum

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


* Office environment with school\-aligned office hours (Tuesday\-Saturday) with attendance at events outside of regular working hours. *During the school year, the Academy team must be present on Fridays from 12pm \- 9pm, and Saturdays from 8:30am \- 4:30pm****.***
* This role works on site throughout the school year, especially Fridays and Saturdays, with hybrid work arrangement available where operations and programming permit.
* Extended periods of sitting and computer use.
* Tight deadlines.
* Works with confidential issues and data including minors.
* A valid Vulnerable Sector Screening Check (VSC) is a required condition of employment.
* The role does not include direct reports.
* This opportunity is for an existing vacancy.
* *AI Disclosure:* AI is not being used to screen, assess, or select applicants.

**How to Apply**
----------------


Interested candidates are asked to submit a cover letter and current résumé online (please upload a single file combining both documents) at www.rcmusic.com/about\-us/careers\-royal\-conservatory. Applications will be accepted until a suitable candidate has been identified.


*The RCM thanks all applicants for their interest in this position; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.*


The RCM is committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and accessible workplace. In accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code, the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, 2005, and the RCM’s Human Rights, Inclusion and Equity Policy, accommodation will be provided at any stage of in the recruitment and selection process. Applicants are asked to make their accommodation needs known when they have been contacted for an interview.

**What is the Opportunity?**
----------------------------


The Manager, The Phil and Eli Taylor Performance Academy for Young Artists is responsible for the school’s management and administration. Reporting to the Assistant Director, the role provides administrative support and is responsible for coordinating various school and student bookings and maintaining online platforms. The Manager is a primary collaborator with several internal departments. In addition to this, they ensure that all required communications are distributed and collected from students, parents, faculty, and enquiries are responded to in a timely manner.  



**Main Duties \& Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------


* Manage front desk and Academy email; first point of contact for internal and external inquiries and updates.
* Liaise with faculty and internal departments for weekly schedule and setup requirements.

* Process and track contractor invoices and POS transactions.
* Collect student information and work with internal departments to maintain Academy accounts and rosters, supporting safety processes.
* Collect and maintain attendance records, notify students/families/faculty as needed, supporting safety processes.
* Collect and track class marks; prepare and enter grades into the Student Information System.
* Create event programs in coordination with faculty and staff.
* Attend all Academy events, providing on\-site support as needed.
* Attend outreach engagements when staff facilitation is necessary.
* Provide audition and jury support.
* Maintain content for Taylor Academy sections of the website.
* Assist in overall marketing plan for each year, including promotion, recruitment, outreach, and alumni engagement; collaborate on social media content.
* Review and distribute all Academy concert recordings.
* Maintain archival records and histories.
* Hire musicians for internal concerts and events as needed.
* Support staff and faculty in program delivery.
* Perform other administrative duties, as required.

  

  

  

**Job Requirements:**  

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Exceptional communication skills (verbal \& written) with internal and external stakeholders at all levels demonstrating tact and diplomacy at all times.
